sentences.text: At New Moon the Moon passes between the Sun and Earth; the face turned toward us is dark and it is invisible beside the Sun in the sky.
Not every new moon brings an eclipse, because the Moon's orbit is tilted five degrees to Earth's and its shadow usually passes above or below Earth.
New Moon week brings the darkest skies for stargazers: this year it coincides with the Geminid peak.
You are watching the orbit speeded up: the Moon completes its phases by circling Earth in twenty-nine and a half days.
